title: fix: default insecure configuration for silk ui
author: johnny-official
body_preview: ### Description  The `django-silk` profiling and inspection UI is unauthenticated and unauthorized by default (`SILKY_AUTHENTICATION` and `SILKY_AUTHORISATION` are `False`). This means that if `django-silk` is deployed to a production environment without explicitly configuring these settings, anyone with network access to the `/silk/` URL can view sensitive application data, including request/resp...
